title: Leaf Season & Fall Real Estate in Boone NC
excerpt: Every October, the Blue Ridge transforms into something that stops people mid-sentence — and for many visitors, that first real look at fall foliage is also the moment they start seriously thinking about owning a piece of it. Here's what the High Country real estate market looks like right now, and why fall might be the smartest time to make your move.
